Package com.egradx.notification.spi

Interface EgradxRecipientDirectory

All Known Implementing Classes:
EgradxAuthRecipientDirectory
public interface EgradxRecipientDirectory
Who is in an audience — every member of an organization, or every user — for bulk sends.

With egradx-auth, egradx-notification-auth implements this from organization memberships. Only active users belong in an audience.

Paging is by user id, ascending, starting after a given id. That — rather than page numbers — is what makes a bulk send resumable: the expansion records the last id it reached, and people joining or leaving meanwhile shift nothing it has not reached yet.

  • Method Details

    • count

      long count(EgradxRecipientDirectory.Audience audience)
      How many are in the audience now — checked against the bulk-send cap before anything is queued.

    • page

      List<UUID> page(EgradxRecipientDirectory.Audience audience, UUID after, int limit)
      Ids in ascending order as the implementation orders them — any consistent order will do.

      The first page is asked for with after == null, not with a "lowest possible id": there is no id that is lowest in every ordering. PostgreSQL compares UUIDs as unsigned bytes, Java's UUID.compareTo as signed longs, so a sentinel of all zeros is first in one and lands mid-way in the other — and every id before it would be silently skipped. (That is not hypothetical: it is the bug this contract's first version had.)

      Parameters:
      after - the last id of the previous page; null for the first page
      Returns:
      at most limit user ids after after, in the implementation's order
